_comment: Nynorsk copy deck for the homepage (#193). Keys are the exact English strings on website/index.html; the build at scripts/build_homepage.py makes /nn/ from them. A key the page no longer has, or a string the page has and this file does not, fails the build. Values equal to their key are deliberate: a brand, a file path, an in-game menu name on an English client, or a placeholder.
